text_block_list.text:
During our meeting,
Mejiro McQueen seemed totally lost in thought.
Concerned, I spoke up to her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—...Huh? Ah.
I'm sorry, I spaced out for a second.
Maybe I'm just tired from the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must brace myself.
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I must always remain in peak condition...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I'm fine now.
Um... so, anyway.

It seems fatigue is still lingering.
For the sake of her future success, should I reconsider her upcoming race schedule...?
